property_summary: For any admissible call, after setOwner(newOwner) succeeds the public getter c.owner() must equal exactly the newOwner argument passed in; the mutant instead stores msg.sender, so for any newOwner != the admin caller the invariant breaks.
change_summary: Replace 'owner = _owner;' with 'owner = payable(msg.sender);' so the caller's address is stored instead of the given argument.
